spec_match.rationale: The wizard's live tests call the real requestStorageAccessFor, hasStorageAccess, and requestStorageAccess surfaces, and the code panes show the actual replacement shapes (in-iframe rSA, CHIPS Partitioned attribute).

interactive.rationale: Four-step tabbed wizard with use-case checkboxes, scenario switcher, three live API tests, and a timeline — all driven by real controls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card's promise of a step-by-step wizard with live tests and a full deprecation timeline.

edge_cases.rationale: Each live test has removed/rejected/resolved branches with explanatory text; the timeline explicitly notes stepped-rollout variance across installs.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5162221567082496, MDN requestStorageAccess, and MDN CHIPS.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 suite encodes the same removal-plus-survivors contract the wizard demonstrates.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile after final edits (screenshots read). CDP sweep walked all four steps, switched all three scenarios, ran tests A/B/C (NotAllowedError, true, resolved) and confirmed the current timeline entry reads 'Chrome 153 — removal rollout'; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; every test renders explicit textual outcomes.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; step tabs and nav buttons override background and color together; timeline markers reuse accent tokens.

accessibility.rationale: Stepper uses role=tablist/tab with aria-selected kept in sync; checkboxes are label-wrapped; results are textual.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; compare rows and nav rows wrap, and the stepper tabs shrink without horizontal overflow.

openQuestions.title: Re-sync the timeline if ChromeStatus moves the removal rollout step again
openQuestions.detail: The predecessor's timeline mixed real and unverifiable milestones (Chrome 128/136/148); the v153 timeline now cites BCD (Chrome 119 ship), the July 2024 and April 2025 announcements, and the ChromeStatus rollout steps (144 deprecation, 153 removal). The removal step already moved once (152 → 153), so a future move would require updating this page's timeline and the feature index lede together.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive migration wizard step tabs without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let tab strips and comparison panes wrap/stack with intrinsic minimums instead of forcing a single row.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Step tabs are flexed with small font and the compare-row panes stack at 16rem basis; harness confirmed no overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep tab semantics (role, aria-selected) synchronized with visual state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: goToStep() updates aria-selected alongside the active class on every navigation.

summary: v153 refile of the migration wizard. Beyond milestone updates, the deprecation timeline was corrected against verifiable sources (BCD Chrome 119 ship; July 2024 / April 2025 announcements; ChromeStatus rollout steps 144 deprecation, 153 removal) replacing the predecessor's unverifiable Chrome 128/136/148 entries. Verified end-to-end via CDP (all steps, scenarios, and live tests) with zero console errors.
